policy.identity: Exact original CCD LEA 0634320 / CA-3768338 with full CA-3768338-sssssss school IDs mapped to full 3768338sssssss CDS. Names and suffix-only matches never join.
policy.year: Only 2024–25 CCD/Census Day eligibility and 2025 Smarter Balanced outcomes.
policy.income: Own same-year CALPADS Census Day K–12 FRPM eligible count divided by own K–12 enrollment, including applications, alternate income forms, direct and categorical certification. Eligibility differs from universally available meals, age5–17 measures and LCFF unduplicated pupil count.
policy.assessment: Smarter Balanced B, All Students group1, separate Math2/ELA1. Complete native expected grades3–8 use verified Overall Total valid-performance-score counts as aggregation weights. Grade13 all grades3–8 and11 is retained and reconciled; it never recovers suppressed/missing component grades. CAA and other assessments never pool.
policy.counts: Overall Total equals the sum of four performance levels and Total Students Tested with Scores; met-plus-exceeded counts reconcile to published two-decimal rates. At least11 valid scores per expected grade. Enrollment and tested participation never replace valid scores.
policy.scope: Prospective lower profiles require agreeing CCD/native lower configuration and applicable grades3–8; substantive lower/high conflict is separate. P versus KG low-bound differences are retained with California preschool-reporting notes, without changing tested grades. CCD missing/suppressed membership never means zero or replaces the native income denominator.
policy.charters: Retain exact roster charter flags. Reporting-prefix charters outside exact CCD LEA membership remain outside; no name, prefix or funding label grants district membership.
policy.programs: Only original administrative school/educational-option/charter labels are verified; magnet/selective/virtual-provider/admissions attribution remains unknown. A name is not program evidence.
policy.combined: Equal mean of usable Math and ELA proficiency; retain separate subject valid-score denominators, never a synthetic paired tested count.
policy.eligibility: Reconstruct exact operational same-year NCES/CDS identities, agreeing CCD/native lower configurations, complete expected native grades 3–8 and verified score-count aggregation, plus own individually eligible CALPADS Census Day K–12 FRPM/enrollment. Retain all 143 lower profiles; Porter and Nipaquay remain unavailable without missing component recovery, Fletcher retains own native income despite missing CCD enrollment, and John Muir remains outside the conflicting grade scope. Reporting-prefix charter and NPS records do not join.
policy.models: Separate unweighted centered San Diego Unified 2025 grade-school Math, ELA and independently fitted paired Combined OLS. Combined is the equal mean of verified subject rates with its own residual scale, explicit deleted fits and external studentization. No enrollment weights, shrinkage, clipping, diagnostic exclusions, grade percentage averaging or national pooling.
policy.studentization: All explicit leave-one-out fits require rank two and positive finite residual scales. Externally studentized residuals use N−3 deleted residual degrees of freedom and held-out prediction leverage. Cook distance, leverage and prediction sensitivity are descriptive only; preserve income extremes and every influential member.
policy.intervals: Every eligible subject has verified valid-performance-score counts from complete expected grades. Jeffreys p=(rate/100*n+0.5)/(n+1), v=10000*p*(1−p)/n. Combined uses (sqrt(vMath)+sqrt(vELA))²/4, the maximum positive covariance bound. Propagate every model member through (I−H), holding each deleted regression scale fixed, for approximate conditional external-t ±1.96SE intervals. These assume fixed income/design, independent school rate errors and approximate binomial variability; they do not represent all uncertainty or causal effects.
policy.combined_count_display: Combined displays the smaller verified native Math/ELA valid-score count only; it is not a paired, deduplicated or joint denominator. Preserve both subject counts and use both subject variances with maximum positive covariance.
policy.compact_provenance: The full immutable source retains 3,789 needed original records / 169,260 typed cells, all headers/primary definitions and exact inventories for 18,189 omitted rows. Numerical artifacts link that complete evidence once with exact table/member/worksheet/row/field pointers. Every current, cached or supplied-expected authorization verifies full source/code/tests/original files and literal raw/schema/definition/identity/policy/runtime contracts, then independently rebuilds inputs and fits. Caller expectations or reassignable caches cannot authorize themselves.
policy.release: Numerical audit only pending independent review and separate normalized/canonical/browser integration. Both historical source and numerical approvals remain false; verified counts and intervals do not grant publication approval.

retained_source_reference.note: Complete original typed records, headers, primary definitions, omitted inventories and outside identities remain in the immutable linked source artifact, required freshly on every numerical replay.

review_warnings: Conditional sampling intervals propagate every member’s verified valid-performance-score denominator binomial approximation while holding deleted regression scale fixed; they do not measure causal school effects or all sources of uncertainty.
Conventional leverage, Cook distance and residual flags require descriptive review, never automatic exclusions.

Census Day individual FRPM eligibility, K–12 enrollment, exact roster/grade agreement, complete expected-grade coverage and the difference between score and enrollment populations remain explicit limits; predictions are never clamped.
Combined uses maximum positive subject covariance and displays the smaller original subject count, not a paired or deduplicated denominator.

intervals.method: Every eligible subject has verified valid-performance-score counts from complete expected grades. Jeffreys p=(rate/100*n+0.5)/(n+1), v=10000*p*(1−p)/n. Combined uses (sqrt(vMath)+sqrt(vELA))²/4, the maximum positive covariance bound. Propagate every model member through (I−H), holding each deleted regression scale fixed, for approximate conditional external-t ±1.96SE intervals. These assume fixed income/design, independent school rate errors and approximate binomial variability; they do not represent all uncertainty or causal effects.
intervals.combined_count_display: Combined displays the smaller verified native Math/ELA valid-score count only; it is not a paired, deduplicated or joint denominator. Preserve both subject counts and use both subject variances with maximum positive covariance.
intervals.assumptions: Approximate conditional 95% intervals: independent school rate errors, smoothed binomial variances from verified native grade-count aggregate rates, fixed income/design and fixed deleted regression scale; all model members contribute. Combined takes the maximum positive Math/ELA covariance bound.

diagnostics.interpretation: Descriptive influence flags only; no school is excluded by leverage, residual or fit quality. Original score-count aggregation, CALPADS Census Day individual FRPM income, regular Smarter Balanced scored scope and approximate conditional sampling assumptions remain limitations; predictions are never clamped.

independent_verification.method: Centered full OLS; centered closed-form leverage; every explicit leave-one-out fit uses N−3 scale and held-out variance factor 1+h_deleted. Independent scalar centered hat weights propagate every member’s verified Jeffreys variance through (I−H); conditional external-t endpoints hold each explicit deleted scale fixed. Combined uses the maximum positive Math/ELA covariance variance bound and preserves both original scored counts; its smaller display count is not a paired denominator.

review_warnings: Conditional sampling intervals propagate every member’s verified valid-performance-score denominator binomial approximation while holding deleted regression scale fixed; they do not measure causal school effects or all sources of uncertainty.
Conventional leverage, Cook distance and residual flags require descriptive review, never automatic exclusions.

Census Day individual FRPM eligibility, K–12 enrollment, exact roster/grade agreement, complete expected-grade coverage and the difference between score and enrollment populations remain explicit limits; predictions are never clamped.
Combined uses maximum positive subject covariance and displays the smaller original subject count, not a paired or deduplicated denominator.

intervals.method: Every eligible subject has verified valid-performance-score counts from complete expected grades. Jeffreys p=(rate/100*n+0.5)/(n+1), v=10000*p*(1−p)/n. Combined uses (sqrt(vMath)+sqrt(vELA))²/4, the maximum positive covariance bound. Propagate every model member through (I−H), holding each deleted regression scale fixed, for approximate conditional external-t ±1.96SE intervals. These assume fixed income/design, independent school rate errors and approximate binomial variability; they do not represent all uncertainty or causal effects.
intervals.combined_count_display: Combined displays the smaller verified native Math/ELA valid-score count only; it is not a paired, deduplicated or joint denominator. Preserve both subject counts and use both subject variances with maximum positive covariance.
intervals.assumptions: Approximate conditional 95% intervals: independent school rate errors, smoothed binomial variances from verified native grade-count aggregate rates, fixed income/design and fixed deleted regression scale; all model members contribute. Combined takes the maximum positive Math/ELA covariance bound.

diagnostics.interpretation: Descriptive influence flags only; no school is excluded by leverage, residual or fit quality. Original score-count aggregation, CALPADS Census Day individual FRPM income, regular Smarter Balanced scored scope and approximate conditional sampling assumptions remain limitations; predictions are never clamped.

independent_verification.method: Centered full OLS; centered closed-form leverage; every explicit leave-one-out fit uses N−3 scale and held-out variance factor 1+h_deleted. Independent scalar centered hat weights propagate every member’s verified Jeffreys variance through (I−H); conditional external-t endpoints hold each explicit deleted scale fixed. Combined uses the maximum positive Math/ELA covariance variance bound and preserves both original scored counts; its smaller display count is not a paired denominator.
